issues.description: Docstring/config disagree on v3 default speaker — aditya vs shubh
issues.detail: The PR description and module docstring both say bulbul:v3-beta default speaker is 'aditya'. TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. One of them is wrong, and users will hit silently-different behavior depending on which they read. Pick one, fix the other, done. This is exactly the kind of inconsistency that wastes a maintainer's afternoon in six months.

STT v3 model + endpoint refactor, TTS v3 model + enum explosion, and the dataclass-driven config rewrite of existing v2.5 dispatch are three logically independent changes. Bisect lands on a single blob. Split into: (1) refactor v2.5 string-sniffing to ModelConfig table, no behavior change; (2) add saaras:v3; (3) add bulbul:v3-beta. Each reviewable in minutes.

issues.description: Removed input_audio_codec from STT connect kwargs without explanation
issues.detail: The diff drops 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec from connect_kwargs in _connect(). No mention in the description. Either the SDK no longer accepts it (say so in the commit message) or this is a silent regression for v2.5 users who set a non-default codec. State the why in the commit message or restore it.

issues.description: Gratuitous Enum hierarchy for speaker names that get stringified anyway
issues.detail: SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist only to materialize a tuple of string values into TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS.speakers. The runtime check is membership in a tuple of strings. The enums add 30+ lines and a parallel taxonomy users now must learn alongside the raw string the API actually wants. A frozenset of strings does this job. Bad taste: special-cased class-per-model where a data table suffices.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 for unknown models
issues.detail: Unknown model name returns v2 speakers instead of raising or returning empty. That's a special case that hides bugs — caller asks 'what speakers does bulbul:v4 support' and gets a confident wrong answer. Either KeyError or empty list; don't lie. Same MODEL_CONFIGS dict already raises ValueError on construction — be consistent.

issues.description: No tests shown for model validation, endpoint routing, or param rejection
issues.detail: The whole point of the ModelConfig table is to make set_language/set_prompt/__init__ reject wrong combinations. Description lists no test additions. Prose in the PR body is not a regression suite. Add tests that fail without this patch for: prompt-on-saarika raises, language-on-saaras-v2.5 raises, saaras:v3 hits non-translate endpoint with mode kwarg.

review.summary: The refactor from string-sniffing ("saarika" in model.lower()) to a ModelConfig data table is genuinely good taste — it eliminates the special cases the previous code accumulated. But the patch is three patches glued together (v2.5 refactor, STT v3 add, TTS v3 add), and it ships with a default-speaker contradiction between docstring and code, a quietly removed input_audio_codec field, a swallow-unknown-model fallback in get_speakers_for_model, and no visible tests. Split it, fix the speaker default, and prove the validation works with tests. NEEDS-WORK.
